about: Facts measured by FORMATS-P1 from native captures through `echodemo rows` (tools/import/measure_native.py facts). src/import/import_facts.h is pinned to these rows by tests/import/test_facts.cpp.

H0.evidence: team 0 (blue) stands at z<-60 and team 1 at z>60 in both sources; SimState ori chirality up .979/.974, fwd.v .548/.596, left-hand-on-Rx .977/.974 vs API head .971/.582/.965; a pure x mirror would need the API to swap hand labels too. T2 still owns the final x proof.

H1.evidence: com + handOff lands on the disc in grip (median 0.105/0.113 m, API holding-hand cluster p10 0.100 m); handOff is hand - com in world axes; native handOff y median -0.782/-0.667 vs API hand-head y -0.692, so com = head within the +-0.1 m the two native captures differ by.

H2.evidence: hmdOri is yaw-only (tilt 0.11 deg quantisation on 90-94% of rows) so it is not the API head basis; its yaw differs from the head by p50 38-59 deg where API body-vs-head is 8 deg, so no API field carries it. BodyBasis is the nearest yaw-only frame; its visual effect is a P8 check.

H3.evidence: SimState ori tilt p50 11.8/13.2 deg, pitch p50 -2.6 deg vs API head 13.8 deg / -5.4 deg; the three chirality numbers match the API head basis (see H0).

H4.evidence: mean R_ori^T R_hand matches the API mean R_head^T R_hand: diagonals 0.40-0.56 native vs 0.41-0.53 API; the largest native-vs-API difference (0.15) is below the 0.18 the two native captures differ by, where a swapped or negated hand axis would move a diagonal by 0.5 or more.

H5.evidence: the disc owner stays set after the throw: 47.7%/48.1% of owned rows are over 1 m from the owner's hands at p50 9.5 m/s; the API holding_*==disc behaves the same (40.9% over 1 m).

O-2.discIdValue.evidence: every tag-1 body row in A (20274) and B (6142) carries component id 0

I-1.geoBitLeft.evidence: with only 0x20 set the left hand (com+lHandOff) moves p50 0.057/0.063 m/s and the right 1.10/1.35 m/s

I-1.geoBitRight.evidence: with only 0x40 set the right hand moves p50 0.064/0.064 m/s and the left 1.10/1.17 m/s

I-5.idleWord.evidence: AND of bits28 over all 205112 rows is 0x10

I-7.boostSpanS.evidence: 0x100 span median 0.2222 s over 1274 spans (p10 0.200, p90 0.2256)

I-9.thrusterAxis.evidence: acceleration in hand frame while one thruster bit is set: 0x400 -> left hand mean (0.03,-0.03,0.44), 0x800 -> right hand (0.04,-0.01,0.44); the other hand's resultant is 0.11-0.17

p7.about: FORMATS-P7 T1 (DESIGN-FORMATS 9.2): native captures reduced to API-like files by tools/import/validate_infer.py, re-inferred by import_inferprobe. Thresholds tuned on A (2026-09-24_12-59-23) only; B (2026-09-20_19-20-29) held out. A gated rule is enabled only when B meets precision >= 0.85 and recall >= 0.50 at 30 and 15 Hz. No gated rule passed, so import_facts.h keeps the design thresholds; the most precise combination found on A is recorded below, not adopted.

I-2.evidence: FIX-F2: gated like I-7..I-10. movingAttachedMinSpeed tuned on A over 0.001..10 m/s; the design 0.001 scores B30 P 0.027 R 0.108, and no value reaches the gate on A or B
